abstract: Two years after testicular resection was carried out in a 40-year-old man that revealed mixed germ cell tumor of more than one histological type (seminoma, embryonal cell carcinoma, and yolk sac tumor), he presented with an asymptomatic pulmonary nodule in his left lower lobe. Video-assisted thoracoscopic partial resection of the tumor revealed a 24 x 20 mm teratoma with somatic-type malignancy in which pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma was a major element. One year later, asymptomatic tumor recurrence occurred at both edges of the stapler line as 22 x 20 mm and 10 x 5 mm nodules composed only of pleomorphic rhabdomyosarcoma. Throughout the course there was no abdominal lymph node swelling detected by computed tomography (CT) and tumor markers were normal. Adjuvant chemotherapy was started after the tumor recurrence. Currently, the patient is still undergoing chemotherapy 5 months after the tumor recurrence. In conclusion, despite the fact that primary pulmonary rhabdromyosarcoma is a rare neoplasm, metastatic pulmonary germ cell tumor with somatic-type malignancy showing predominantly rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation should be considered in the differential diagnosis of such lesions of the lung.
abstract_ja: 40歳男性が、精巣切除により混合型胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ、胚細胞癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍)と診断されてから2年後、左下葉に無症状の肺結節を呈した。胸腔鏡下の部分切除により、横紋筋肉腫が主要な成分である体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う24×20 mmの奇形腫が認められた。1年後、自動縫合器のライン両端に、多形性横紋筋肉腫のみからなる22×20 mmおよび10×5 mmの結節として無症状の腫瘍再発を認めた。経過中、CTで腹部リンパ節腫大は認められず、腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。腫瘍再発後に補助化学療法を開始し、再発から5か月時点でも化学療法を継続中である。原発性肺横紋筋肉腫は稀な腫瘍であるが、主として横紋筋肉腫様分化を示す体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う転移性肺胚細胞腫瘍は、このような肺病変の鑑別診断に含めるべきであると結論する。
